snippet.title: The Hat Man – Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4347270/The_Hat_Man/
Wishlist on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-hat-man-cb045e

The Hat Man is a short first-person psychological horror game inspired by the Hat Man urban legend.

Survive escalating sleep paralysis encounters using breath control, blinking, and focus. 
Every mistake brings The Hat Man closer.

Multiple endings. Free to play.

Coming April 29th, 2026.

Also coming soon to:
GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/thehatman/1053342
itch.io: https://blacklanternentertainment.itch.io/the-hat-man
